jyutping: jau4 sai1 min6 ceoi1 lei4 ge3 N

english.note: Use this specifically when N is a wind blowing from the west, rather than merely something located to the west.

examples.english: The western wind is pretty strong today.
examples.traditional: 今日由西面吹嚟嘅風幾大。
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 jau4 sai1 min6 ceoi1 lei4 ge3 fung1 gei2 daai6
